source.sourceCheck: HEAD and tree read back in the isolated worktree matched the fixed candidate exactly; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no was empty; the build-emitted identity matched commit/tree/clean and the runner asserted it before navigation.

serialPreflight.priorTowerInvocation: Closed. The tower unit result recorded the CLI closed with exit code 0 (close seen), the turn ended with a result, and tools settled. Its own exit evidence recorded empty cleanup arrays, zero remaining Chromium processes, and no preview listener.
serialPreflight.priorResidualProcessCheck: Cross-checking the tower unit registered process subtree against the current process census by PID and creation time found every registered entry exited except one inert Git head.exe text-filter process left by a prior shell pipeline. It is not a browser, preview server or GPU task, is not an ancestor of the tower invocation, and holds no serial slot. Full PID evidence is retained locally only.
serialPreflight.browserProcesses: No Chrome, Chromium or headless-shell browser process was present.
serialPreflight.nodeSmokeProcesses: No node process ran browser-smoke/run.mjs and no vite preview/dev server process was present.
serialPreflight.userDesktopApps: User-owned desktop apps (Edge, VS Code and a Unity editor) were present. They are not receiver GPU/browser jobs and were not touched; no receiver browser or GPU task was running.
serialPreflight.sharedGpuLock: No GPU slot or capture lock state existed. The receiver's own job lock held this unit and was not cleared, modified or used as exit evidence; the receiver state listed only this unit as running.
serialPreflight.serialCondition: Known-clear; this unit ran one headless browser and one software-renderer smoke task.

preparation.method: Used the existing tests/client/browser-smoke/run.mjs unchanged. Movement is a real page.mouse right-click followed by a real S keydown; targeting and abilities use real Q/E/R key presses; save/resume uses the real Save match button, a real page reload and the real Continue saved match button. No simulation state was injected, and no source, script, lockfile, browser security configuration or test threshold was modified.

npmCiOffline.note: Existing lockfile only; no network install and no browser download.

preparation.cpuSuitesNotRerun: Per task, the same-tree 71-file/464-item CPU suite, npm run build, final npm run build:web and the already-run sim checks were reused, not rerun in this unit.

smokeBuild.command: npm run build:web (inside npm run smoke)
smokeBuild.exitCodeBasis: The single npm run smoke chain returned 0; build:web runs first and the browser runner executed afterward, so a build failure would have aborted the chain.
smokeBuild.note: A fresh build produced web-dist and its emitted build-identity.json; no cached or stale bundle was reused.

smokeRun.command: MOBA_SMOKE_SOURCE_SHA=<fixed 9777b84> MOBA_SMOKE_RENDERER=software MOBA_SMOKE_OUTPUT=<exclusive run dir> npm run smoke

botAdvance.basis: post-run read-only snapshot observation; see report.json botAdvance

browser.argvNote: Full argv and the local user-data/profile path are retained only in the local raw report.

exit.previewClosedMeaning: After server.close() the runner fetched its own preview origin; the fetch rejected, so the same-process listener was closed and the ephemeral port was unreachable.
exit.postRunProcessCheck: The recorded browser process was absent after the run; zero chrome/chromium/headless-shell processes, zero smoke/preview node processes and no preview listener remained. The npm/runner chain used for this run had exited. Full PIDs are retained locally only.

rendererCaveat: MOBA_SMOKE_RENDERER=software was requested and the actual WebGL renderer was SwiftShader software. This round passes the functional gate only; it is not a GPU capture, does not claim GPU rendering, and does not judge visual quality, feel, audio, multiplayer, or superiority over the default.
boundary: Functional smoke evidence only. Default entry remains v10 and candidate.html remains v11. No source, script, lockfile, browser security configuration or test threshold was changed; no default-entry switch, merge or deployment was made.

botObservation.basis: post-run read-only snapshot observation; same record as report.json botAdvance; not a run.mjs assertion
botObservation.envelopePath: LocalMatch.step -> Simulation.commandFrame -> Simulation.step (source-verified; boundary not instrumented at runtime)
botObservation.cleanup: The observation page, browser and preview server were closed in the script finally block with no reported close error.
